speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I need to evaluate the skin lesion you are concerned about; can you describe exactly what the bump or patch looks like, including its size, color, and any changes you've noticed recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC) of the Penis and Skin.
The patient's history of a non-healing, crusty lesion, combined with his heavy smoking history and failed treatments for syphilis/eczema, strongly suggests a malignant process. I need to confirm the extent of the lesions and rule out other causes.
REQUEST TEST: Biopsy of penile lesion and finger lesion.
REQUEST IMAGES: Dermoscopy of penile and digital lesions.
